item.title: [New] Intune PowerShell script assignments stop applying while a targeted Entra group is soft-deleted
item.description:
Deleting a group silently stops hardening or remediation scripts from applying to its members; an intruder with group-admin rights could use that to strip a control without touching Intune.

Intune · Alert on deletion of groups used in Intune script or configuration assignments (AuditLogs: Delete group) and check assignment status for Soft-Deleted.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [New] Intune maintenance window policies set when Windows update downloads, installs and restarts may start
item.description:
A maintenance window also bounds how fast an emergency security update lands; a narrow window on servers or kiosks delays patching of an exploited flaw.

Intune · If you adopt maintenance windows, document how an out-of-band security update overrides them and keep the window wide enough to meet your patch SLA.

item.title: [New] Intune raises the minimum iOS/iPadOS and macOS Company Portal to v5.2608.0 from early February 2027; devices that block App Store installs need a pushed update
item.description:
A device stuck on an older Company Portal can fall out of enrolment and compliance flows, which Conditional Access device-compliance policies depend on.

Intune · If 'Block installing apps using App Store' is enabled for supervised iOS/iPadOS devices, or macOS devices install Company Portal only through Intune, push Company Portal v5.2608.0 before early February 2027; warn the help desk about the update prompt.
